gui.hephaestus_tools.build.repair_hint.old: Insert a tool plus a raw material matching its head to repair 25% durability, or a tool part to swap it the old part is returned to you.
gui.hephaestus_tools.build.repair_hint.new: Insert a tool plus a raw material matching its head to repair %s durability, or a tool part to swap it the old part is returned to you.

gui.hephaestus_tools.build.repair_button.old: Hammer the material into the tool (each one restores 25% durability)
gui.hephaestus_tools.build.repair_button.new: Hammer the material into the tool (each one restores %s durability)

gui.hephaestus_tools.build.workbench_rep.old: Drop the head material on the tool to repair it. Each one restores 25% durability, and the repair uses everything it needs at once. You can also put a part of another material on the table and drag it onto the tool to swap it. The old part stays on the table.
gui.hephaestus_tools.build.workbench_rep.new: Drop the head material on the tool to repair it. Each one restores %s durability, and the repair uses everything it needs at once. You can also put a part of another material on the table and drag it onto the tool to swap it. The old part stays on the table.

trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.demonic.desc.old: Jagged, siphons blood on hit and mends with Blood Mending.
trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.demonic.desc.new: Siphons blood on hit and mends with Blood Mending.

trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.magical.desc.source: Sometimes releases aspect orbs from ores and slain foes, and gathers more from vis crystals.
trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.magical.desc.translation: 有时会从矿石和击杀的敌人中释放要素球, 并能从灵气水晶中收集更多.

trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.magically_ja.source: Magical and jagged, deals bonus magic damage, mends itself, carries warp and can restore your runic shield.
trait.ftbevolutioncompanion.magically_ja.translation: 兼具魔力与锯齿, 造成额外魔法伤害, 自我修复, 带有扭曲, 并可恢复符文护盾.
